defs.def: with no people or things inside 空的

ex.s: It was then that I realised her seat was empty!
ex.t: 就在那时，我意识到她的座位是空的！

defs.def: with no meaning; not meaning what is said 言语或行动

ex.s: Mum voiced what we were all thinking: It was strange to see the place so empty.
ex.t: 妈妈说出了我们所有人的想法：看到这个地方如此空荡荡，感觉很奇怪。

defs.def: unhappy because life does not seem to have a purpose, usually after sth sad has happened 人或其生活

ex.s: （10分）Haze Mabry， who has worked as a school keeper for thirteen years， walks into the school building every day and empties garbage cans， wipes down bathrooms and mops wet messes in the hallways．
ex.t: 21．（10分）Haze Mabry 在学校做了十三年保洁工，每天走进教学楼，清空垃圾桶，擦拭卫生间，拖干走廊上的湿污。

defs.def: without a quality that you would expect to be there 没有；缺乏；无

ex.s: Otherwise, the recreation of traditions would be artificial and empty, he said.
ex.t: 这对他来说完全足够了。

defs.def: to remove everything that is in a container, etc. 倒空；腾空；掏空

ex.s: To reduce our impact, we can take simple steps: empty the fridge before heading out, and choose sustainable dining options.
ex.t: 为了减少我们的影响，我们可以采取简单的步骤：出门前清空冰箱，并选择可持续的就餐选择。

ex.s: As I rushed outdoors to empty the wastepaper baskets, the door swung shut behind me.
ex.t: 当我匆忙跑到户外去倒废纸篓时，门在我身后砰地关上了。

ex.s: As a result, they burned more fat during walks on an empty stomach than when they had eaten first.
ex.t: 结果，他们空腹走路时燃烧的脂肪多于先吃饭时。

ex.s: They take their driverless car to an appointment and set the empty vehicle to circle the building to avoid paying for parking.
ex.t: 他们开自动驾驶汽车赴约，让空车绕楼转圈以逃避停车费。

ex.s: Each empty can of its food weighs 40g.
ex.t: 它的食物每个空罐头重40克。

ex.s: My fridge is usually half empty and I’m often too tired to eat much anyway.
ex.t: 我的冰箱通常半空着，而且我常常累得吃不下多少东西。

ex.s: It as an empty subject a But it is vital not to take any chances.
ex.t: it 作形式主语 a 但绝不能心存侥幸，这一点至关重要。

defs.def: to take out the contents of sth and put them somewhere else 把 … 移出，把 … 腾出（置于别处）

ex.s: Then, in 2015, cleaners in an Italian gallery threw away an art piece after mistaking the pile of empty bottles, cigarette ends and pieces of coloured paper for rubbish!
ex.t: 然后，在 2015 年，一家意大利画廊的清洁工误把一堆空瓶子、烟头和彩色纸片当成垃圾，扔掉了一件艺术品！

defs.def: to make sure that everyone leaves a room, building, etc. （把 … ）撤出，撤离；撤空
to flow or move out from one place to another 流入；涌进

chunks.en: empty fridge / bottles / subject / vehicle / stomach / garbage
chunks.cn: 变空冰箱 / 变空细颈）瓶子 / 变空学科 / 变空车辆 / 变空胃 / 变空生活）垃圾
